capabilities.title: Stateless password derivation: generate passwords deterministically from site+login+master
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LessPass core algorithm: PBKDF2 over site+login+counter+master → password, no storage needed
capabilities.reason: Deterministically deriving many credentials from one master secret creates cross-site correlation and master-compromise blast radius. Nexus keeps its unbiased Web Crypto generator independent and ephemeral.

capabilities.title: Zero storage/sync: no database, no cloud sync, passwords reconstructed on demand
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LessPass design: passwords are computed, never stored
capabilities.reason: Generated credentials remain in component memory only, are never persisted or sent to a provider, and clear automatically. Nexus adopts zero-storage generation without deterministic reconstruction.

capabilities.title: Open algorithm specification: any client can reproduce the derivation with the same inputs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: LessPass open spec: published algorithm and test vectors
capabilities.reason: Nexus's project-owned generator and sealed-envelope algorithms are readable, validated, and covered by executable test vectors; reproducible deterministic credential derivation itself remains excluded.
